settings.seoTitle: Domeček Janov | Whole holiday house in Bohemian Switzerland
settings.seoDescription: An entire holiday house for up to 17 guests, 6 bedrooms, a 4,000 m² fenced garden and a hot tub in Janov near Hřensko.
settings.heroTitle: The whole house, just for your group.
settings.heroDescription: Six bedrooms for up to 17 guests, 4,000 m² of fenced garden and a hot tub. The Hřensko gorges are two kilometres from the house.

accommodation.introTitle: One big house for three or four families.
introText: Domeček sits in a quiet part of Janov, a few minutes above Hřensko. It is always rented as a whole - six bedrooms, the large kitchen and dining room and the garden are yours alone.
Most of our guests are families with children, groups of friends, sports teams or small companies on a team-building trip. The house is open all year round.

janov.title: Janov lookout tower
janov.description: The tower stands right in the village. A short walk with views over the Elbe Sandstone Mountains.

hrensko.title: Hřensko gorges
hrensko.description: A punt ride through the canyon of the Kamenice river. In season set off early - afternoons get busy.

pravcicka.title: Pravčická brána arch
pravcicka.description: The largest sandstone arch in Europe. Drive to Hřensko or Mezní Louka, then continue on foot.

jetrichovice.title: Jetřichovice viewpoints
jetrichovice.description: A loop past the Mariina, Vilemínina and Rudolfova viewpoints. Allow three to four hours of walking.

actions.tourIssue: Trouble with the tour? Open it separately

garden.title: Four thousand square metres|of fenced garden.
garden.description: The terrace with the grill faces south. The garden has a trampoline, a swing and a playhouse - and because the whole plot is fenced, you can let the children out of sight.
garden.cardText: A heated hot tub on the terrace. If you want it, we will have it ready for your whole stay.

rooms.title: Fifteen beds|in six bedrooms.
rooms.description: Five rooms upstairs, one step-free room on the ground floor and two sofa beds in the living room - up to 17 places to sleep in total.

trips.title: A different direction|every day.
trips.description: Janov sits on the edge of Bohemian Switzerland National Park, two kilometres above Hřensko. The gorges, rock viewpoints and the Pravčická brána arch are within walking distance or a few minutes by car.

pricing.title: The whole house.|No strangers.
